en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing an industrial complex in a rural, forested landscape. Several factory buildings with tall brick chimneys stand near piles of timber and rough ground in the foreground. Smaller wooden houses and outbuildings are scattered around the site, with dense forest and low hills in the distant background. The word "Klevfoss" is printed in simple type near the upper left of the image.
